claims.explanation: JNJ-26481585 (quisinostat) is a pan-HDAC inhibitor whose selectivity is best explained by dependence on HDAC1/2/3-mediated chromatin remodeling and acetylation-driven apoptosis, which is enhanced when p53-dependent apoptosis is intact and when the tumor is not protected by strong survival signaling. Lines with TP53 mutation/dysfunction and intact apoptotic effectors (e.g., melanoma with BRAF, thyroid, Ewing sarcoma) are enriched among sensitive lines, while lines with mutations that activate survival or alter chromatin (e.g., PTEN loss, SMARCA4/ARID1A loss, CREBBP/EP300 mutation) tend to be less affected. High HDAC1/2/3 expression and low expression of multidrug/anti-apoptotic programs are predicted to sensitize.
